artworks.title: Disparate desordenado (Disorderly Folly)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and drypoint [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: The image shows a group of human figures in an intense scene. Two central figures are displayed, with one shirtless and wrapped in a sheet-like material around their lower body, standing upright and gesturing towards a kneeling figure. The kneeling figure faces left, displaying prominent facial features with exaggerated expressions. The figure wears a flowing garment and seems to be crouched or seated, looking up towards the standing figure. Other figures with similarly exaggerated and distressed expressions are gathered around them, some wearing long, flowing clothing. The background is dark and blurry, with indistinct forms and shapes adding to the dramatic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Los ensacados (The Men in Sacks)
artworks.medium: etching and burnished aquatint [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: This is a painting of cloaked, ethereal figures in a dimly lit scene. The image depicts a group of ghostly forms gathered closely together, each draped in flowing, cloak-like garments. The figures appear to be floating above the ground or hunched over slightly. The background is an ambiguous, dark shade that contrasts with the lighter tones of the figures. This piece involves an intricate play of light and shadow, emphasizing the eerie and mysterious nature of the composition. The overall effect is unsettling yet captivating.

artworks.title: Disparate general (General Folly)
artworks.medium: etching and burnished aquatint [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: The image features a group of human-like forms in motion, energetically depicted in various poses against a dark background. The scene has a dramatic and chaotic feel, with figures seemingly interacting dynamically. The overall atmosphere is intense and somewhat eerie, characterized by densely applied textures and shadows. The figures are roughly sketched, contributing to a sense of movement and energy. The lack of distinct boundaries and the blending of forms create ambiguity, leaving the viewer to infer the narrative.

artworks.title: El caballo raptor (The Horse-Abductor)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person being tossed by a wild horse. The image shows a figure being thrown backward off a rearing horse, with the horse's head turned away from the viewer. The figure is upside down, with arms flailing and a slightly distressed expression on its face. The background is minimalistic, composed primarily of varying shades of monochrome.

artworks.title: Disparate pobre (Poor Folly)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, most seen from head to toe. The central figure is a woman with her arms raised, body slightly turned to the side. Her facial expression appears fearful yet determined, with her hair styled up. She wears a long, dark dress with puffed sleeves. There are other figures around her, with one seeming to move towards her urgently. None of the figures have visible jewelry. The surroundings are depicted with dark and rough hatchings, implying an outdoor or transitional space. The background shows dark shades and faint outlines.

artworks.title: Disparate allegre (Merry Folly)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a dynamic pose. The image depicts several figures appearing to dance or move energetically. The ambiance conveys lively movement, with each figure positioned in various gestures, some with arms raised. The figures are wearing period clothing. The use of shading enhances the dynamic feel, with a contrast between light garments and a dark background. The figures' expressions suggest humor or merriment. The artwork features strong lines and attention to detail in the figures' apparel.

artworks.title: Modo de volar (A Way of Flying)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and (drypoint?) [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: The image features figures with wings in flight. Multiple figures with various wing types are soaring through a dark sky. The central figure has bat-like wings, while smaller figures have different styles of wings. The night sky serves as a backdrop for the flight scene.

artworks.title: Disparate de Carnabal (Carnival Folly)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint [trial proof printed posthumosuly circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group of figures engaged in an interaction. The scene shows various figures in distinct poses and attire. Two central figures are in the foreground, bending forward with others around them in motion. Some figures wear long coats and hats. In the background are more figures, with some obscured by shadows or other characters. The composition has a theatrical tone, capturing a moment of dynamic behavior among the figures.

artworks.title: Disparate claro (Clear Folly)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and lavis  [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: It is a drawing of figures gathered under a canopy. The image depicts a group engaged in an activity beneath a large canopy. The figures are in shadow with highlights creating dramatic lighting. The drawing has intricate lines and hatching for texture and depth. The interplay between light and dark draws attention to the expressions and gestures of the figures.

artworks.title: Sanan cuchilladas mas no malas palabras (Wounds Heal Quicker than Hasty Words)
artworks.medium: etching and burnished aquatint [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of six figures in a dynamic arrangement. From left to right, there is a person with their arms around the shoulders of another who is stumbling. The center figure wears a cloak-like garment and has a wide-eyed expression. A child is holding the hand of the central figure. The fifth person is leaning forward with a hand on their head, and the sixth figure stands at the far right, gesturing with one hand. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: La lealtad (Loyalty)
artworks.medium: etching and burnished aquatint [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaging in a scene of confrontation or chaos. The composition features nine characters gathered around the central figure, each depicted in dynamic poses with exaggerated expressions that convey tension or hostility. The figures are rendered in a dark and heavily shaded style, casting dramatic contrasts. The scene feels intense and slightly surreal, with an atmosphere suggesting a narrative of conflict or accusation.

artworks.title: Dios los cria y ellos se juntan (God Creates Them and They Join Up Together)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished aquatint and burin  [trial proof printed posthumously circa 1854-1863]

artworks.title: The Jester Barbarroja
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, burin and roulette [proof] on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright facing slightly to the right. He has detailed facial features, including a pointed nose, intense eyes, and a bushy beard. His hair is tucked under a headpiece, and he is dressed in long, flowing robes with voluminous sleeves, a cloak draped over one shoulder, and boots rising to mid-calf. The man is holding a sword in his right hand, with the sword's tip resting on the ground. The background is a dark, textured surface, contrasting with the light-toned figure.

artworks.title: Esto es lo verdadero (This Is the Truth)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, burin and burnisher in umber on laid paper [trial proof printed posthumously by Lefort and/or in the Calcografia c.1870)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures embracing in a glowing light with a basket of objects and a creature nearby. The drawing shows a scene where a figure with long hair leans on an axe, looking toward another figure dressed in elaborate clothing, both surrounded by an aura of radiating light. Nearby, a creature resembling a small bear or large dog explores a basket filled with items. The scene is set against a backdrop of dense foliage, with intricate detailing and cross-hatching. The radiating lines of light intensify the focus on the central figures, giving a dramatic quality to the composition.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a seated knight in detailed armor. The knight has a relaxed posture with one leg crossed over the other. The knight wears a helmet with intricate designs and a plume, and a fur cloak drapes over his shoulders. He is holding an ornate mace, with one hand resting on it. His armor features straps, buckles, and rivets. A shield is placed against the base where he sits. The background is minimal, with a plain, light surface.

artworks.title: Spring: The Shooting Range
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. It features a group of people gathered in a park surrounded by tall trees, with various postures and activities depicted. Beyond the park are buildings nestled among trees, suggesting a small community. The horizon is low in the composition, with more trees marking the distant edge. The sky dominates the upper half of the image. The artwork is detailed, with fine lines defining the foliage and figures. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: Autumn: The Wine Market
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside town with buildings, including a tall cathedral spire on the left. The artwork uses detailed line work, mainly in black and grey tones. In the foreground, there is a busy quay with people, barrels, and boats. The river flows through the scene with boats and a bridge in the distance. Stylized clouds fill the sky above.

artworks.title: Winter: The Parade Ground
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a vibrant town square from a bird's eye view, featuring numerous buildings and a variety of activities below. The artwork is detailed, with an emphasis on architectural elements and figures in the scene. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of gray dominating the image. People are depicted engaging in different activities, while various buildings and structures can be seen in the background.

artworks.title: Under Manhattan Bridge
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a marketplace set beneath an arched stone structure. Vendors are seen behind tables selling goods, with baskets in the foreground. The background features an arched gateway and stone blocks. Textures and shading techniques are used to show details of the architecture and market scene.

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures gathered around a bed, with one figure lying in repose. The scene includes detailed robes and solemn expressions, with a kneeling figure holding a garment or cloth and facing a candle on a table. The setting features intricate drapery, a crucifix, and religious books. Above the primary scene is a smaller depiction of a religious procession or burial. The drawing shows a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

artworks.title: The Falconer and Noble Lady
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in a stylized pose. The man on the left stands with his body slightly angled to the right, one hand holding a falcon and the other gesturing with his coat. He has long, wavy hair cascading over his shoulders, topped with a cap adorned with tall feathers. His clothing comprises a long robe over a striped garment. To his side is a woman, facing slightly towards him. Her hair is styled intricately and encircled with a wreath embellished with a veil. She wears a long, flowing dress with draped sleeves. Her hands are delicately positioned, one holding a piece of fabric. The scene is adorned with decorative swirls and ribbons above their heads. The background is textured, adding depth to the image, and the ground is punctuated with a few plants.

artworks.title: The Lute Player and the Singer
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man. The woman is seated, facing the man, with her head slightly tilted and her hands positioned as if she is accepting or examining an object given by the man. She has a serene expression, a soft-featured face, and is wearing a headdress covering her hair. She wears a long gown with ample sleeves and sits on a bench against a wall. The man is standing or leaning against the wall with one foot raised on a platform. He is playing a lute, looking at the woman. He has curly hair, wears a hat, a tunic, leggings, and holds a stick. In the foreground, a dog sits with a leash on the ground. The background shows an archway, a closed door with a lion-head knocker, and a round object on the wall. The image is in an engraved style, emphasizing textures in clothing and architecture.

artworks.title: Ragotin lie par les parents du fou
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a prone figure and a cart in a rural setting. The scene shows two figures interacting with the figure on the ground. The standing figures are dressed in attire reminiscent of an earlier period with hats and capes. In the background, there are trees and a lightly sketched landscape with a cart drawn by a horse. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette with shading to create a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: On trouve le corps mort de l'hote que l'on avait cache
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of women in a domestic interior. The scene depicts four women in an artistically detailed interior setting. One figure is leaning forward with arms raised, while the others are engaged in searching or displaying activities around the room. The fireplace houses a decorative relief or mirror with intricate designs. The artist has used shading and highlights to create depth and texture, emphasizing the fabric of the women's gowns. The use of contrasting white chalk on brown paper enhances the overall dramatic effect of the scene.
